style: High-quality 3D animated feature film still, close to photoreal (modern big-studio animation look), bright warm light, rich detail, cinematic depth of field. Vertical 9:16, keep the top third fairly simple (text sits there). Ancient Arabia.

scenes.s1: A breathtaking lush garden of grapevines on wooden trellises heavy with purple grapes, bordered by tall date palms, green crop fields and a sparkling stream running between two gardens, golden morning sunlight.
scenes.s2: In the lush vineyard, a proud wealthy man in his forties with a short dark beard, wearing a rich embroidered crimson robe and a white turban with a gold band stands proudly with his chin raised, one arm sweeping over the vines, speaking boastfully to a humble man in a plain brown robe and simple white head wrap who stands beside him listening quietly. Medium shot, both seen from the side, natural expressions.
scenes.s3: Close medium shot of a proud wealthy man in his forties with a short dark beard, wearing a rich embroidered crimson robe and a white turban with a gold band, proud smile, gesturing at the heavy grape vines around him as he speaks, golden light, vineyard behind him.
scenes.s4: a humble man in a plain brown robe and simple white head wrap speaking gently and sincerely, one hand on his chest, the vineyard behind him in soft light. Medium shot from the side.
scenes.s5: The same garden at grey dawn after a violent night storm: grapevines collapsed onto their broken trellises, fruit scattered and rotting on the mud, palm fronds torn, the stream muddy. No people.
scenes.s6: a proud wealthy man in his forties with a short dark beard, wearing a rich embroidered crimson robe and a white turban with a gold band, his crimson robe muddy, standing in the ruined vineyard at dawn, turning his hands over in grief and regret, head lowered, collapsed trellises around him. Medium shot from the side.
scenes.s7: A small healthy green vine with a few fresh leaves growing in soft golden sunrise light, peaceful and hopeful, dew drops. No people.
